subject: POC: prompt set & eval dataset collection - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@acmecorp.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC: prompt set & eval dataset collection - next steps

Hi Samuel / Asha \u0014

Thanks again for the conversation today \u0014 great to hear how Acme is thinking about integrating an LLM assistant into your internal support flows. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can kick off the POC next week:\u2028

Summary / success criteria (per today)
- Accuracy: responses should be >= 85% helpful on your 200-sample evaluation set (we will define exact rubric).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 800ms for 512-token outputs on Dedicated tier.
- Cost: target inference cost <= $0.03/1000 tokens (goal, we\u2019ll iterate).
- Safety & data handling: no customer PII in model outputs; we\u2019ll run sample checks.

What we need from you for the evaluation
1) Prompt set: 150\u2013300 representative prompts from your helpdesk logs (mix of short/long, multi-turn where applicable). Prefer CSV (prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_behavior/label).
2) Logs: 2\u20133 days of anonymized session logs (redact PII) to help us reproduce context / prefixes.
3) Evaluation owners & timeline: who will own grading/review of model outputs and a target delivery date for the dataset.

Timeline & owners
- You provide prompt set + logs by EOD 2026-08-27. (owner: Acme test lead)
- Redwood returns initial eval run + summary within 5 business days of receipt.
- Deliverables
- Template for prompts (CSV) and a short eval rubric \u2014 attached.
- Initial eval report with sample outputs and suggested model/quantization profile.

Attachments: poc-intake-form.pdf (POC intake + redaction guidance)

Questions / outstanding items
- Are there any corporate controls we should be aware of for file transfer? We can accept a secure S3 presigned upload or a Drive link.

Thanks \u2014 I\u2019ll follow up with the template and a Drive link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: prompt set & eval dataset collection - next steps

Hi Marissa \u2014

Thanks for the clear recap. This lines up with what we discussed. Asha will own the prompt collection on our side and I\u2019ll oversee the evaluation criteria. A few quick Qs:\u2028
- We can pull ~200 prompts from last quarter\u2019s triage logs \u2014 is CSV fine? (yes)
- For logs: we\u2019ll redact names and emails and provide session timestamps + conversation turns. Is that sufficient for reproducing context?
- Any special handling for secrets/attachments inside the logs? We\u2019ll strip attachment contents and surface filenames only.

We expect to have the prompts + sample logs to you by EOD 2026-08-27. If there\u2019s anything else you need (formatting, additional fields), let us know.

Also happy to sign a narrow data handling addendum if required.

\u2014Sam
Samuel Lee
Head of Support Intelligence
Acme Corp

Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: prompt set & eval dataset collection - next steps

Sam \u2014 thanks, that timeline works. A couple of notes:\u2028
- CSV is perfect. Use columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_label, context (optional), notes. We attached a sample template as well.
- Redaction guidance: remove direct identifiers (names, emails, account numbers). If you\u2019d like, we can run an automated PII scan on the dataset before ingestion.
- Transfer options: secure S3 presigned or a Drive folder (link below). For audit purposes, please include a short manifest (who collected, date range, any transformations).

Drive link (pooled folder for the POC): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF-poc-acme

I\u2019ve added the deal to HubSpot (link) and flagged the SRE/SE pair for the run. Deal ID: DEAL-ACME-2026-004 \u2014 we\u2019ll draft the trial SOW after we validate the dataset.

If EOD 8/27 is tight, let me know and we can get a 2-day extension. Otherwise, we\u2019ll plan to start the eval so we can deliver results the week of 8/31.

Thanks \u2014
Marissa
